verdict.rationale: Pinecone's own docs describe creating backups of serverless indexes through the SDK, API, or console, which covers the snapshot/backup half of the story. Restore is only implied by the phrase "copy indexes" and is not explicitly documented in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit documentation of restoring an index from a backup, coverage beyond serverless indexes (e.g. pod-based collections), independent or hands-on corroboration of the backup/restore workflow.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can back up collections with snapshots and restore them
